meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

response.text:
If your main concern is **active acne, blackheads, clogged pores, or oily skin**, I’d buy a **2% salicylic acid serum** rather than a plain niacinamide serum. Salicylic acid directly helps unclog pores, while niacinamide is particularly useful for oil control and post-acne marks. [blog.flash.co](https://blog.flash.co/serum/top-10-salicylic-acid-serums/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My picks under ₹700

### [Minimalist Salicylic Acid Face Serum]()
*₹224*

### [The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Face Serum]()
*₹314*

### [Deconstruct Anti-Acne Clearing Serum]()
*₹524*

### [The Derma Co. 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum]()
*₹237*

**🥇 Best overall: Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** — around **₹224–₹549** depending on seller/size. It's a straightforward choice if you mainly have pimples, blackheads and clogged pores. [www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/serum-for-open-pores?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥈 Best for acne + acne marks: The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide** — **₹449 on the brand's site**, with **2% salicylic acid + 5% niacinamide**. This is the one I'd choose if you have both active breakouts and leftover marks. [thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/products/sali-cinamide-anti-acne-serum-with-2-salicylic-acid-5-niacinamide-30ml?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥉 Best gentler alternative: Deconstruct Anti-Acne Clearing Serum** — currently around **₹524** in the shopping results. Good option if you don't want to jump straight into a stronger-feeling BHA routine.

### What I'd choose for you

- **Mostly active pimples/blackheads → Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid**
- **Pimples + dark acne marks → The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide**
- **Sensitive/reactive skin → consider a lower-strength niacinamide serum instead**

Start salicylic acid **2–3 nights per week**, not every night, and use moisturizer + **SPF 30–50 every morning**. Don't combine it initially with multiple other exfoliating actives.

If you tell me **your skin type (oily/dry/combination), whether you have active pimples or mainly acne marks, and your age**, I can narrow it down to **one serum** for you.
